text:
Ravi: Quick thread 1: I opened a tiny PR to clarify locale fallbacks and residency notes in docs/availability/locale-fallbacks.md. Found two problems: (1) the fallback order implied 'en-US' default for all regions, which is misleading for Regional-hosted customers; (2) a stray sentence referenced 'data residency beta' which we retired. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3512
Hannah: Thanks. Can we add an explicit example table showing header + resulting endpoint selection? e.g. header X-Redwood-Region: apac -> endpoint api.apac.redwood.ai. That helps localizers.
Marco: Agree on table. Also suggest we add a short note under "Fallback rules": 'If a region-specific model is unavailable, the request will route to the nearest compatible region unless the customer has strict residency enabled.'
legal-bot: Legal guidance: use exact phrase for residency: "Strict residency: customer data is processed and stored only within the selected region's jurisdictions." Add link: https://redwood.ai/legal/data-residency. Avoid words like 'always' or 'guaranteed' without contract reference.
docs-bot: CI / docs/link-check 1: failed on docs/availability/locale-fallbacks.md: inline link to /legal/data-residency 404.
Ravi: I'll fix the link to the canonical URL. Also will add the small example table and remove the retired beta sentence.
Hannah: For localization teams, can we include an i18n note: "Localized UI messages may fall back to en when region-specific translations are unavailable; this does not affect residency or hosting." Keeps expectations clear.
Marco: One more thing: we should not list region slugs that we don't support. Replace any 'china' or 'cn' mentions with 'apac' until product announces China region.
Ravi: Pushed changes: replaced fallback wording, added demo table, fixed legal link, and added an Availability callout: 'Strict residency is available for Private and Dedicated plans; contact sales.' Also updated quickstart snippet to set header example instead of env var.
docs-bot: PR #3512 checks: snippets ok, link-check ok, spellcheck warns on 'behaviour' vs 'behavior' (varies by locale).
Hannah: Nits addressed in a follow-up commit. Added small clarifying sentence for translators.
Ravi: Merged at 1739997880. Notifying #eng-infra to ensure routing logs show region slug for easier debugging. Thanks team :rocket:
